description:
Operate the quick-capture buffer queue that feeds daily logs and, through them, tasks.

Subcommands:
  add TEXT — append an UNKNOWN entry (raw capture; blocks `tend` and `flush` until converted)
  suggest TEXT [-y] — propose a structured add-* for raw text (INTERACTIVE unless -y)
  add-text THREAD TEXT — append a TEXT entry
  add-ref THREAD TARGET [SUMMARY] — append a REF entry
  add-action THREAD TEXT [--due YYYY-MM-DD] [--scheduled YYYY-MM-DD] [--priority H|M|L] [--depends UUID8] — append an ACTION entry; also reachable as `tasks add`
  list [FILTER] — show the buffer with line numbers
  rm LINE_NUMBER — remove a single line by line number
  tend — regroup by thread and date, then validate; idempotent
  flush — tend, then write entries into logs/ and clear the buffer

Flags:
  top level: --quiet suppress info output.
  suggest: -y auto-accept the suggestion without prompting.
  add-action: --due YYYY-MM-DD applied on flush and ingest; --scheduled YYYY-MM-DD; --priority one of H, M, L; --depends 8 hex chars, repeatable.

Examples:
  ["add-action", "Projects/SGB", "(Riaz Arbi) Send the signed contract", "--due", "2026-06-15", "--priority", "H"]
  ["add-text", "Processes/Admin", "Bank confirmed the new mandate"]
  ["list"]
  ["flush"]

Notes:
  Call `suggest` only with -y; without it, it prompts on stdin.
  Avoid `add` — UNKNOWN entries are deliberately invalid and block `flush` until removed with `rm` and re-added via an add-* subcommand.
  THREAD must resolve to an existing thread file; create it with `threads new` first.
  One capture per line; no multi-line entries.
  Ordering: add-* then `tend` to validate, then `flush` to write logs and empty the buffer, then run `tasks` to turn flushed ACTION lines into TASK anchors.
  Do not edit the buffer file directly; use these subcommands and `tend` to fix problems.
  Exit 1 on empty text or description, a malformed --due or --scheduled, or a --depends that is not 8 hex chars.
